name: Dubai Makers & Small Shops
about: Independent makers, repairers, artists, and small shops sharing process, advice, and fair local collaborations.

stories.author: p70
stories.text: Small shops deserve clear hours and clear prices.

stories.author: p31
stories.text: Sketching the old market colours today.

posts.author: p70
posts.text: Small-business owners: which detail did you wish you had documented before your first collaboration? Mine is agreeing who owns the final photos.

comments.author: p31
comments.text: Usage rights and delivery dates, in writing. Friendly projects still need a clear note.

comments.author: p70
comments.text: Yes, and naming the files consistently saves a surprising amount of time.

comments.author: p34
comments.text: I also record deposits and what happens if a delivery date moves.

comments.author: p13
comments.text: A one-page scope is enough; it does not need to sound like a huge contract.

posts.author: p14
posts.text: I have a few oak offcuts available for a beginner shelf workshop in Al Quoz. Who would like a small, practical project rather than a perfect one?

comments.author: p63

comments.author: p14
